title: Rabbi Chana bar She’onah
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Avodah Zarah 75a: they said, “How much is an onah?” Rav Chana She’onah — and some say Rav Chana bar She’onah — said that Rabbah bar bar Chana said that Rabbi Yochanan said. In Niddah 65b the reading is “Rav Chana She’onah, and some say Rav Chana bar She’onah.” Seder HaDorot holds that he is one with Rabbi Yochanan bar She’onah, mentioned in Vayikra Rabbah 5:2.

notes.text: The consulted Avodah Zarah text gives Rabbi Chana Sheina or Rabbi Chana bar Sheina. The supplied notice has the Shaonah spelling and uses Rav in the quoted chain.
